entries.title: Psalms 94:1
segments: O God of vengeance, Jehovah, God of vengeance, shine forth!

entries.title: Psalms 94:2
segments: Lift up Yourself, Judge of the earth; give a just repayment to the proud.

entries.title: Psalms 94:3
segments: How long [shall] the wicked, O LORD, how long shall the wicked exult?

entries.title: Psalms 94:4
segments: They gush; they speak impudent things; all the workers of iniquity speak proudly.

entries.title: Psalms 94:5
segments: They crush Your people, O LORD, and afflict Your inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 94:6
segments: They kill the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

entries.title: Psalms 94:7
segments: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, nor shall the God of Jacob observe [it].

entries.title: Psalms 94:8
segments: Understand, you beastly ones among the people; and fools, when will you be wise?

entries.title: Psalms 94:9
segments: He who planted the ear, shall He not hear? He who formed the eye, shall He not see?

entries.title: Psalms 94:10
segments: He who chastens the nations, shall He not correct, He who teaches man knowledge?

entries.title: Psalms 94:11
segments: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they [are] vain.

entries.title: Psalms 94:12
segments: Blessed [is] the man whom You chasten, O LORD, to teach him out of Your law;

entries.title: Psalms 94:13
segments: that You may give him rest from the days of trouble, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 94:14
segments: For the LORD will not cast off His people, nor will He forsake His inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 94:15
segments: But judgment shall return to righteousness; and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

entries.title: Psalms 94:16
segments: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

entries.title: Psalms 94:17
segments: Unless the LORD [had been] my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

entries.title: Psalms 94:18
segments: When I said, My foot slips; Your mercy, O LORD, held me up.

entries.title: Psalms 94:19
segments: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Your comforts delight my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 94:20
segments: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship [with] You, which frames mischief by a law?

entries.title: Psalms 94:21
segments: They gather themselves against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

entries.title: Psalms 94:22
segments: But the LORD is my defense; and my God [is] the rock of my refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 94:23
segments: And He will bring on them their own iniquity, and He will cut them off in their evil. The LORD our God shall cut them off.
